question: According to the source, what was the date of writing of the island memorandum?

sources.body_html:
Filed documentary sheet

Catalogue slip.

The island memorandum was written on April 12, 1909.

The island memorandum was received on April 18, 1909.

The inspection occurred on March 3, 1909.

Publication date: May 2, 1909.
sources.title: Filed documentary sheet
